sum: Pure Cycle Corporation provides water and wastewater services in the United States. It operates in three segments: Water and Wastewater Resource Development, Land Development, and Single-Family Rental. The company owns or controls water supply and infrastructure to withdraw, treat, store and deliver water; collect, treat, and reuse wastewater; treat and deliver reclaimed water for irrigation and industrial use, including non-potable irrigation of parks and open spaces. It also provides raw water for industrial oil and gas operations; and wholesale water production, storage, treatment and distribution systems, and wastewater collection and treatment systems. In addition, the company develops master planned communities; and owns, develops, and lease single-family homes. It serves domestic, commercial, and industrial customers. Pure Cycle Corporation was incorporated in 1976 and is headquartered in Watkins, Colorado.
ceo: Mr. Mark W. Harding (President, CEO, Principal Executive Officer & Director)
